help.guide.hold.s1: Tap Hold — the basket is saved and shown as a small button above the tabs.
help.guide.hold.s2: Serve the next person. When the first customer returns, tap their saved basket to continue.
help.guide.hold.title: 5 · Customer forgot something?
help.guide.intro: Everything you need for a normal day, in small steps. You cannot break anything by trying — take your time.
help.guide.language.s1: Tap the language letters at the top of the screen (for example EN or FA) and pick yours. Everything changes at once.
help.guide.language.title: 8 · Change the language
help.guide.login.s1: Turn the till on. When the number pad appears, type your PIN.
help.guide.login.s2: You are in! The big screen with product pictures is where you sell.
help.guide.login.title: 1 · Start your day
help.guide.noscan.s1: Type the first letters of the product's name in the box at the top — it will find it.
help.guide.noscan.s2: Or tap the product's picture on the screen.
help.guide.noscan.s3: If your till has the camera button 📷, tap it, take a photo of the product, and pick the right match.
help.guide.noscan.title: 6 · The barcode won't scan
help.guide.pay.s1: When everything is in the basket, look at the Pay area.
help.guide.pay.s2: Tap Cash if they pay cash, Card if they pay by card. That's it — the sale is done.
help.guide.pay.s3: Paying part cash, part card? Use the Split tab and add each payment.
help.guide.pay.title: 3 · Take the money
help.guide.receipt.s1: After paying, the receipt appears. Tap Print if the customer wants a copy.
help.guide.receipt.s2: Tap New customer and you are ready for the next person.
help.guide.receipt.title: 4 · Receipt and the next customer
help.guide.sell.s1: Point the scanner at the barcode — beep — the item appears in the basket on the left.
help.guide.sell.s2: No barcode? Tap the product's picture instead.
help.guide.sell.s3: You can also type the name or code in the box at the top and press Add.
help.guide.sell.title: 2 · Sell something
help.guide.shift.s1: Go to Shifts in the menu and tap Open shift — count the cash in the drawer and enter it.
help.guide.shift.s2: At the end of the day, go back to Shifts, count the drawer again, and close the shift.
help.guide.shift.s3: The till shows any difference for you — no maths needed.
help.guide.shift.title: 7 · Opening and closing the day
help.guide.title: How to use the till
help.guide.trouble.s1: Internet down? Keep selling — the till works without it and catches up later.
help.guide.trouble.s2: Tapped something by mistake? Nothing is lost — the basket stays until you finish or reset it.
help.guide.trouble.s3: Still stuck? Ask your manager, or open Help / FAQ in the menu for more answers.
help.guide.trouble.title: 9 · Something looks wrong?

settings.backup.confirm_required: Type RESTORE in the confirmation box to restore a backup
settings.backup.help: The till saves a daily snapshot of its database automatically (newest 14 are kept). Download copies to a USB stick or another device — a backup that lives only on this machine cannot save you from a broken machine.
settings.backup.none_yet: No backups yet — the first daily snapshot happens a couple of minutes after the till starts.
settings.backup.restore_note: Restoring replaces ALL current data with the backup (the replaced data is kept in the backups folder). The till applies it on the next restart.
settings.backup.staged: Restore staged — restart the till to finish. The current data will be kept as a pre-restore backup.
settings.backup.title: Backups
settings.currency.help: How prices are written on this till: symbol or word, its position, and whether the currency has decimal subunits (pound has 100 pence; rial and toman have none).
settings.currency.title: Currency
settings.currency.warning: Changing the currency does not convert existing prices — amounts stay as entered, only the label and decimals change.
settings.display.help: Scale the whole interface for this till's screen. Small touch panels: 70–80%. Large displays: 130%+.

settings.idle_lock.help: Lock the till when it sits unused. The operator signs back in with their PIN — the basket is kept exactly as it was.

settings.printer.help: Print receipts silently on a thermal printer. Network mode talks to any WiFi/Ethernet ESC/POS printer; device mode writes to a plugged-in USB printer (e.g. /dev/usb/lp0 on Linux/Pi).
